text.tspan: Computation used to train notable artificial intelligence systems
Computation is measured in total petaFLOP, which is 10¹⁵ floating-point operations. Estimated from AI
literature, albeit with some uncertainty. Estimates are expected to be accurate within a factor of 2, or a factor of
5 for recent undisclosed models like GPT-4.
Training computation (petaFLOP) (plotted on a logarithmic axis)
